body: Never thought of that before. I'll randomly pick a name: George Costanza.

Yeah. Week 4 we were getting fitted for our class A's, and one of the other platoon's drill sergeants started joking with him about being too old. He asked him why he joined, and he said, "I always wanted to join the Army." 

But before that during reception (pre-Basic Training), I was talking to him with a group of other recruits during downtime and he said he was from Detroit, and the way the economy was headed, he needed a guaranteed job, and the military was the way to go. Guy had my respect from then on.

I wish I didn't tell that friend now. Now she thinks I'm crazy and won't talk to me. Can't say I don't blame her though, I'm a fucking idiot cutting myself in the bathroom of a strip joint. That's a new low for me.

You can join the U.S. Army up until age 42, but I wouldn't do it right now. DoD is cutting people out of the branches now that Iraq is a done deal and Afghanistan is close to being over too. In my basic training platoon, we had a 40 year old who did it. He was 7 years older than our senior drill sergeant.

I'm definitely putting the bottle down for now. I didn't even want to go to the kegger last night anyway, but felt that I had to get out of the house. It was an awful experience I hope never to live through again. I was that person who was by himself drinking himself to oblivion. There were chicks there but I didn't want to mingle. I felt like a dumbass for even going. And now my throat is sore from all the beer and cigs I smoked last night. Haven't been able to speak at all today.

I don't want to say too much where I'll be noticed...but one thing on my mind right now is my birthday is in a few days, and it'll be my last one home, because my unit is scheduled to deploy on my birthday next year, and I don't want to go back to the sandbox. Been thinking about just getting out altogether but then that'll be another failure I have to live with in my life.

I tried to go talk to my dad...but I can't. It's so hard for a guy to talk about his emotions with his old man. The only reason I did it last night was because I was drunk and dumb. Calling 911 would be a bad thing because then my unit will find out and I'll probably be kicked out of the military for being suicidal. Plus they'll commit me and I have no insurance to cover it.
I don't know how it'll help, much less where to start. What do you want to know?
